title: How Often Should You Detail Your Car in Duncan, BC?
metaDescription: Wondering how often to detail your car in Duncan, BC? Ashton's Auto Detailing breaks down the ideal schedule for the Cowichan Valley's climate and roads.
excerpt: The Cowichan Valley's wet winters and dusty summers put extra wear on your car's paint and interior. Here's the detailing schedule that actually keeps up.

content.text: One of the most common questions we get from customers around Duncan and the Cowichan Valley is simple: how often should I actually get my car detailed? The honest answer depends on how you use your vehicle, but our local climate plays a bigger role than most people realize.
Why the Cowichan Valley is tough on vehicles

Between the wet, mossy falls and winters and the dusty gravel roads common around Mill Bay, Cobble Hill, and Shawnigan Lake, vehicles here accumulate grime faster than in drier climates. Road salt, tree sap, and fine dust work into paint and upholstery in ways that a quick rinse at home won't fully remove.

items: Full detail (interior + exterior): every 3 to 4 months for daily drivers
Exterior-only detail: monthly if you park outside or commute on gravel roads
Interior-only detail: every 2 to 3 months, especially with kids or pets
Pre-winter detail: late fall, to apply paint protection before road salt season

content.text: If water isn't beading on your paint anymore, if your interior has a musty smell, or if you're planning to sell your vehicle, it's worth booking a detail regardless of when your last one was.
